rules.rule: If delivery is delayed beyond estimated date by more than 3 days, customer is eligible for shipping fee refund or a goodwill coupon.
conditions: Delay must exceed 3 days from promised ETA
Customer must contact support to claim
exceptions: Force majeure events (natural disasters, strikes) excluded

rules.rule: If first delivery attempt fails, two more attempts are made on the next two business days before the order is returned to seller.
conditions: Customer must be reachable on registered phone number
exceptions: After 3 failed attempts, order is cancelled and refund is initiated

rules.rule: Delivery address can be changed only before the order is shipped. Once shipped, address change is not possible.
conditions: Change must be in same pincode region for some sellers
exceptions: Address cannot be changed once shipped

rules.rule: Lost shipments are eligible for full refund or replacement after 5 business days of investigation by the logistics team.
conditions: Customer must report non-delivery after ETA passes
exceptions: Shipments marked delivered but not received require additional verification
